entries.description: Investigated Web app AddDabblerSecurity config vs API. Found: Web has no RegisterPages/Entities/Endpoints/Controls calls, no security seed data, and uses NullUserListProvider. ResourceRegistry is empty causing empty dashboard tabs.

Added RegisterPages (7 pages), RegisterEntities (5 entities with fields), RegisterEndpoints (21 endpoints), and RegisterControls (5 controls) to Web app AddDabblerSecurity call. Created EfUserListProvider and registered it to replace NullUserListProvider.

Verified UseJsonFileStore already configured in Web app. security-config.json already exists with seeded role hierarchy, page/entity/endpoint/control permissions, field permissions, and row filters. No additional persistence changes needed.

security-config.json already contains complete seed data (4 roles, 7 page permissions, 5 entity permissions, 5 field permissions, 20 endpoint permissions, 5 control permissions, 1 row filter). No additional seeding needed.

Registration calls added: 7 pages, 5 entities (with fields), 21 endpoints, 5 controls. ResourceRegistry now populated. SecurityConfigurationManager loads from existing security-config.json. EfUserListProvider registered. Dashboard tabs should now show: Roles (4 roles), Page Access (7 pages), Entity Access (5 entities with CRUD), Endpoint Access (21 endpoints), Control Permissions (5 controls), Row Filters (1 filter), User Assignments (seeded users).

Build succeeded (0 errors, 1 pre-existing warning). All 467 non-Playwright tests pass (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Security 211, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 120, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 8, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 12, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 83). Playwright: 67 passed, 8 pre-existing failures (unchanged).

Investigated security enforcement infrastructure: 5 authorization handlers (Page, Entity, Field, Control, Endpoint), SecurityConfigurationManager singleton with lazy load, JsonFileSecurityStore with atomic writes, role inheritance via RoleInheritanceHelper. Identified existing test patterns (211 tests) and Web app wiring from Session 1.

Created AcmeCoffeeSecurityEnforcementTests.cs with 63 tests covering: page access (15 Theory + 2 Fact), entity CRUD (17 Theory + 1 Fact), field visibility (4 Theory + 2 Fact), control permissions (11 Theory + 1 Fact), endpoint access (10 Theory), persistence round-trip (1 Fact), runtime modification with persistence (1 Fact), manager save-and-refresh (1 Fact), and unauthenticated user denial (1 Fact). Tests use AcmeCoffeeOnline seed data matching security-config.json.

Removed sample project references from Dabbler.Security.Tests.csproj (SampleApp.Api, Dabbler.Security.DevIdp). Deleted DevIdpOidcFlowTests.cs (9 tests) and WebApiIntegrationTests.cs (4 tests) that depended on deleted samples/. Relocated CookieHandler helper into OidcIntegrationTests.cs to preserve those 9 OIDC tests.

Build: 0 errors, 0 warnings. All 517 non-Playwright tests pass (Components 33, Security.Blazor 120, Reports.Blazor 8, Api 12, Security 261, Web 83). Security tests: net +50 (removed 13 sample-dependent, added 63 enforcement).

Cross-provider verification via Gemini completed. Verdict: PASS with observations. 3 low-severity gaps noted: (1) no failure-scenario tests for malformed config, (2) conflict resolution not tested for all permission types, (3) UI rendering via DabblerSecured not tested at integration level (expected to be E2E).
